advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test asserting run_pass(route="sync") on a converged pass returns 0 and writes exactly `BRIDGE_STATE: converged` to stderr.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py:79: `print(canonical_message or f"BRIDGE_STATE: {disposition.state}", file=sys.stderr)`

advisory.suggested_fix: Extend the canonical unit tests to cover the converged disposition, asserting capsys stderr == "BRIDGE_STATE: converged\n".
